title: Feature request - sms commands
symptom: The user asks if there is a way to remotely force collector restart in xDrip, similar to SMS commands in AAPS, or have follower or Nightscout issue restart collector command.
fix: A comment suggests using a Plugin for remote control of Tasker on the phone to start a command to restart collector with the xDrip+ plugin.
evidence_quote: You could use a Plugin for remote control of Tasker on the phone to start a command to restart collector with the xDrip+ plugin.
